scope: Descriptive distribution diagnostics in addition to the locked primary tests
timing: Defined after primary exact/MC audit, before inspecting supplementary folded-distribution outcomes
reason: The reader's winning rate may mean either raw upward rate or the larger of long/short rates; report both without treating the folded distribution as an ordinary binomial
raw_up_sd_and_max: Equal-tail two-sided diagnostics for full-sample SD and maximum; 20 jointly Holm-corrected tests
folded_distribution: Full-sample SD of max(up,down)/n with an equal-tail two-sided p, and fixed-bin histogram discrepancy with an upper-tail p; 20 jointly Holm-corrected tests
draws: Replay the same original seeds, batch512 and complete reselection null draws; not new independent simulations or new evidence
interpretation: Exploratory diagnostics, not additional confirmatory endpoints selected to maximize significance
